## 2. Train new trees
```{r}
cat("\nNN and Mindset variables were mapped to try and apply NNDHS2024 TT to Mindset data, but few variables overlapped. So we recreated a TT based on overlapping variables between the two datasets\n")
```

```{r}
# urban	LCA4_class
# rural	LCA5_class

# Use segment_rank insead of LCAk_class
urban$segment_rank <- as.factor(urban$segment_rank)
urban.kano$segment_rank <- as.factor(urban.kano$segment_rank)
rural$segment_rank <- as.factor(rural$segment_rank)
rural.kano$segment_rank <- as.factor(rural.kano$segment_rank)
```

### 2.1. CART models - with Test and Train approach
#### 2.1.1. Define Functions
```{r}
# Loss matrix: rows = TRUE class, cols = PREDICTED class.
# w[i] = cost of misclassifying a true class-i case.
make_loss <- function(w) {
  L <- matrix(w, length(w), length(w))
  diag(L) <- 0
  L
}

# Per-class sensitivity/specificity + summary metrics, as a one-row tibble
class_metrics <- function(pred, truth, prefix = "") {
  lvl <- levels(truth)
  cm  <- confusionMatrix(factor(pred, levels = lvl), truth)
  s   <- cm$byClass[, "Sensitivity"]
  sp  <- cm$byClass[, "Specificity"]
  out <- c(setNames(s,  paste0("sens_", lvl)),
           setNames(sp, paste0("spec_", lvl)),
           min_sens     = min(s),
           mean_bal_acc = mean(cm$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"]),
           accuracy     = unname(cm$overall["Accuracy"]))
  as_tibble(as.list(round(out, 3))) %>% rename_with(~ paste0(prefix, .x))
}

# Stratified train/test split
# Stratified train/test split (text columns converted to factors first,
# so rare categories are known to the model even if absent from train)
split_data <- function(data, outcome, p = 0.8, seed = 2026) {
  data <- data %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), factor))
  set.seed(seed)
  idx <- createDataPartition(data[[outcome]], p = p, list = FALSE)
  list(train = data[idx, ], test = data[-idx, ])
}

# One weight setting: grow the tree on TRAIN, score every cp on TRAIN only
tune_one <- function(w, fml, train) {
  y <- train[[all.vars(fml)[1]]]
  set.seed(2026)
  fit <- rpart(fml, data = train, method = "class",
               parms   = list(loss = make_loss(w)),
               control = rpart.control(cp = 0.001, xval = 5))
  cps <- fit$cptable[, "CP"]
  
  map_dfr(seq_along(cps), function(j) {
    pruned <- prune(fit, cp = cps[j])
    bind_cols(
      tibble(weights  = paste(w, collapse = "/"),
             cp       = cps[j],
             n_leaves = fit$cptable[j, "nsplit"] + 1,
             xerror   = round(fit$cptable[j, "xerror"], 3)),
      class_metrics(predict(pruned, newdata = train, type = "class"), y)
    )
  })
}

# Run the whole weight grid in parallel
run_grid <- function(weight_grid, fml, train) {
  plan(multisession, workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1))
  on.exit(plan(sequential))
  future_map_dfr(
    seq_len(nrow(weight_grid)),
    function(i) tune_one(unlist(weight_grid[i, ]), fml, train),
    .options  = furrr_options(seed = TRUE,
                              packages = c("rpart", "caret", "dplyr", "purrr", "tibble")),
    .progress = TRUE
  )
}

# Refit the chosen setting on TRAIN and prune
fit_final <- function(pick, fml, train) {
  w <- as.numeric(strsplit(pick$weights, "/")[[1]])
  set.seed(2026)
  fit <- rpart(fml, data = train, method = "class",
               parms   = list(loss = make_loss(w)),
               control = rpart.control(cp = 0.001, xval = 5))
  prune(fit, cp = pick$cp)
}

# Side-by-side train vs test performance for the final tree
compare_train_test <- function(tree, fml, train, test) {
  y_name <- all.vars(fml)[1]
  bind_rows(
    class_metrics(predict(tree, newdata = train, type = "class"), train[[y_name]]) %>%
      mutate(set = "train", n = nrow(train)),
    class_metrics(predict(tree, newdata = test,  type = "class"), test[[y_name]]) %>%
      mutate(set = "test",  n = nrow(test))
  ) %>% relocate(set, n)
}
```
#### 2.1.2 National Urban
```{r}
# --- predictors

fml_urban <- segment_rank ~ hh.toilet.flush + med.dist + tv.yn + muslim + roof + has.mobile +
  hh.noimp.housing + ed.sec.higher + hh.noimp.wall + marr.cohab +
  hh.clean.fuel + med.cost + med.permis + med.alone +
  religion + rad.yn + floor + any.hh.dis + hh.rooms.cat +
  hh.land + hh.animal + working.yn

# ---- 80/20 stratified split ----
urban_split <- split_data(urban, "segment_rank", p = 0.8)
urban_train <- urban_split$train
urban_test  <- urban_split$test
table(train = urban_train$segment_rank)
table(test  = urban_test$segment_rank)

# ---- Grid of class weights (one weight per level, in level order) ----
levels(urban$segment_rank)
weight_grid_urban <- expand_grid(
  w1 = seq(0.25, 2, by = 0.25),
  w2 = seq(0.25, 2, by = 0.25),
  w3 = 1,
  w4 = seq(0.25, 2, by = 0.25)
)
nrow(weight_grid_urban)

# ---- Search on the TRAINING set only ----
results_urban <- run_grid(weight_grid_urban, fml_urban, urban_train)

best_urban <- results_urban %>%
  filter(min_sens >= 0.80) %>%
  arrange(n_leaves, desc(mean_bal_acc))
best_urban %>% print(n = 20, width = Inf)

# ---- Refit the chosen model on TRAIN ----
pick_urban <- best_urban[14, ]          # select the row number after reviewing the table
tree_urban_final <- fit_final(pick_urban, fml_urban, urban_train)

# ---- Performance: training vs held-out test ----
df_compare <- compare_train_test(tree_urban_final, fml_urban, urban_train, urban_test) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

# Full confusion matrices
confusionMatrix(predict(tree_urban_final, newdata = urban_train, type = "class"),
                urban_train$segment_rank)
confusionMatrix(predict(tree_urban_final, newdata = urban_test,  type = "class"),
                urban_test$segment_rank)

prp(tree_urban_final, type = 5, varlen = 0, cex = .5)

saveRDS(tree_urban_final, "national_urban_tree_train_test.rds")
write.csv(df_compare,"national_urban_tree_train_test_performance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### 2.2 CART models - Model Trained on Full Dataset


#### 2.2.1 National Urban
```{r}

lv <- levels(urban$segment_rank)
K  <- length(lv)

fml <- segment_rank ~ hh.toilet.flush + med.dist + tv.yn + muslim + roof + has.mobile +
  hh.noimp.housing + ed.sec.higher + hh.noimp.wall + marr.cohab +
  hh.clean.fuel + med.cost + med.permis + med.alone +
  religion + rad.yn + floor + any.hh.dis + hh.rooms.cat +
  hh.land + hh.animal + working.yn

# Loss matrix: rows = TRUE class, cols = PREDICTED class.
# w[i] = cost of misclassifying a true class-i case.
make_loss <- function(w) { L <- matrix(w, K, K); diag(L) <- 0; L }

# ---- Training-set performance for one loss setting, across all cp values ----
train_by_loss <- function(w1, w2, w3, w4) {
  w   <- c(w1, w2, w3, w4)
  set.seed(2026)
  fit <- rpart(fml, data = urban, method = "class",
               parms   = list(loss = make_loss(w)),
               control = rpart.control(cp = 0.001, xval = 5))
  
  cps <- fit$cptable[, "CP"]
  
  map_dfr(seq_along(cps), function(j) {
    pruned <- prune(fit, cp = cps[j])
    pred   <- predict(pruned, newdata = urban, type = "class")
    cm     <- confusionMatrix(pred, urban$segment_rank)
    s      <- cm$byClass[, "Sensitivity"]
    sp     <- cm$byClass[, "Specificity"]
    tibble(weights      = paste(w, collapse = "/"),
           cp           = cps[j],
           n_leaves     = fit$cptable[j, "nsplit"] + 1,
           xerror       = round(fit$cptable[j, "xerror"], 3),
           !!!setNames(as.list(round(s,  3)), paste0("sens_", lv)),
           !!!setNames(as.list(round(sp, 3)), paste0("spec_", lv)),
           min_sens     = round(min(s), 3),
           mean_bal_acc = round(mean(cm$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"]), 3),
           accuracy     = round(unname(cm$overall["Accuracy"]), 3))
  })
}

# ---- Grid of class weights ----

weight_grid <- expand_grid(
  w1 = seq(.5, 2, by = 0.25),   
  w2 = seq(0.5, 2, by = 0.25),   
  w3 = 1,
  w4 = seq(.5, 2, by = 0.25)
)
nrow(weight_grid)   

# parallel compute
plan(multisession, workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1))

results <- future_pmap_dfr(
  weight_grid, train_by_loss,
  .options  = furrr_options(seed = TRUE,
                            packages = c("rpart", "caret", "dplyr", "purrr", "tibble")),
  .progress = TRUE
)
plan(sequential)


# Settings where every class is >= 80% sensitive:
# smallest tree first, then best balanced accuracy
best <- results %>%
  filter(min_sens >= 0.80) %>%
  arrange(n_leaves, desc(mean_bal_acc))
best %>% print(n = 20, width = Inf)

# ---- Refit and prune the chosen model ----
pick <- best[1, ]
w    <- as.numeric(strsplit(pick$weights, "/")[[1]])

tree_final <- rpart(fml, data = urban, method = "class",
                    parms   = list(loss = make_loss(w)),
                    control = rpart.control(cp = 0.001, xval = 5))
tree_final <- prune(tree_final, cp = pick$cp)

confusionMatrix(predict(tree_final, newdata = urban, type = "class"),
                urban$segment_rank)

prp(tree_final, type = 5, varlen = 0, cex = .5)

saveRDS(tree_final, "national_urban_tree_all_data.rds")

```

#### 2.2.3 National Urban Kano Only
```{r}

lv <- levels(urban.kano$segment_rank)
K  <- length(lv)

fml <- segment_rank ~ hh.toilet.flush + med.dist + tv.yn + muslim + roof + has.mobile +
  hh.noimp.housing + ed.sec.higher + hh.noimp.wall + marr.cohab +
  hh.clean.fuel + med.cost + med.permis + med.alone +
  religion + rad.yn + floor + any.hh.dis + hh.rooms.cat +
  hh.land + hh.animal + working.yn

# Loss matrix: rows = TRUE class, cols = PREDICTED class.
# w[i] = cost of misclassifying a true class-i case.
make_loss <- function(w) { L <- matrix(w, K, K); diag(L) <- 0; L }

# ---- Training-set performance for one loss setting, across all cp values ----
train_by_loss <- function(w1, w2, w3, w4) {
  w   <- c(w1, w2, w3, w4)
  set.seed(2026)
  fit <- rpart(fml, data = urban.kano, method = "class",
               parms   = list(loss = make_loss(w)),
               control = rpart.control(cp = 0.001, xval = 5))
  
  cps <- fit$cptable[, "CP"]
  
  map_dfr(seq_along(cps), function(j) {
    pruned <- prune(fit, cp = cps[j])
    pred   <- predict(pruned, newdata = urban.kano, type = "class")
    cm     <- confusionMatrix(pred, urban.kano$segment_rank)
    s      <- cm$byClass[, "Sensitivity"]
    sp     <- cm$byClass[, "Specificity"]
    tibble(weights      = paste(w, collapse = "/"),
           cp           = cps[j],
           n_leaves     = fit$cptable[j, "nsplit"] + 1,
           xerror       = round(fit$cptable[j, "xerror"], 3),
           !!!setNames(as.list(round(s,  3)), paste0("sens_", lv)),
           !!!setNames(as.list(round(sp, 3)), paste0("spec_", lv)),
           min_sens     = round(min(s), 3),
           mean_bal_acc = round(mean(cm$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"]), 3),
           accuracy     = round(unname(cm$overall["Accuracy"]), 3))
  })
}

# ---- Grid of class weights ----

weight_grid <- expand_grid(
  w1 = seq(.5, 2, by = 0.25),   
  w2 = seq(0.5, 2, by = 0.25),   
  w3 = 1,
  w4 = seq(.5, 2, by = 0.25)
)
nrow(weight_grid)   

# parallel compute
plan(multisession, workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1))

results <- future_pmap_dfr(
  weight_grid, train_by_loss,
  .options  = furrr_options(seed = TRUE,
                            packages = c("rpart", "caret", "dplyr", "purrr", "tibble")),
  .progress = TRUE
)
plan(sequential)


# Settings where every class is >= 80% sensitive:
# smallest tree first, then best balanced accuracy
best <- results %>%
  filter(min_sens >= 0.79) %>%
  arrange(n_leaves, desc(mean_bal_acc))
best %>% print(n = 20, width = Inf)

# ---- Refit and prune the chosen model ----
pick <- best[2, ]
w    <- as.numeric(strsplit(pick$weights, "/")[[1]])

tree_final <- rpart(fml, data = urban.kano, method = "class",
                    parms   = list(loss = make_loss(w)),
                    control = rpart.control(cp = 0.001, xval = 5))
tree_final <- prune(tree_final, cp = pick$cp)

confusionMatrix(predict(tree_final, newdata = urban.kano, type = "class"),
                urban.kano$segment_rank)

prp(tree_final, type = 5, varlen = 0, cex = .5)

saveRDS(tree_final, "kano_urban_tree_all_data.rds")

```
